The passage must be absent from Barthel 1958, Pozdniakov 1996/2007, Horley 2009/2021, Sproat 2003, and the ipezygj parallels3 output, and must be visually confirmed on the tracings. Passages made only of high-frequency formula signs (e.g. repeated 76/200/606 runs) must also beat a shuffle null that preserves local repetition. (B) A merge set derived without held-out tablets that recovers at least 20% more known parallels on held-out tablets than Horley's basic-glyph map, with p < 0.01 against random merge sets of the same size and the same resulting inventory size. Results must hold under at least 2 catalogues (e.g. Barthel codes and Horley basic glyphs). Novelty is checked against the published lists as they stand at verification time.

partial_wins.statement: A new parallel passage meeting every condition of outcome (A) (two different tablets or sections at least 2 lines apart; Bonferroni-corrected p < 0.001 against glyph-shuffled tablets AND the local-repetition-preserving shuffle; substitutions only accepted Barthel/Pozdniakov/Horley allographs beyond 2 mismatches; absent from Barthel 1958, Pozdniakov 1996/2007, Horley 2009/2021, Sproat 2003 and ipezygj parallels3; confirmed on the tracings) except that it spans 7-9 aligned positions instead of at least 10.

A lunar-sequence prediction: a model of Guy's Mamari lunar canon (night-name sequence with intercalary insertions), frozen before searching, finds a sequence of 28-30 aligned positions on a tablet other than Mamari (C) whose alignment to the Mamari calendar beats both shuffle nulls at Bonferroni-corrected p < 0.001, absent from the published parallel lists, visually confirmed on the tracings.

A merge set derived without held-out tablets that recovers at least 10% more known parallels on held-out tablets than Horley's basic-glyph map, with p < 0.01 against random merge sets of the same size and the same resulting inventory size, under at least 2 catalogues.

targets.verification_method: The verifier obtains the corpus via jgregoriods/rongopy or ipezygj/rongorongo-catalogue-audit fetch_data.py (recording hashes) and cross-checks against kohaumotu http pages. It reruns Smith-Waterman with the stated matrix, recomputes both shuffle nulls with Bonferroni correction, diffs against the published parallel lists and parallels3 output, and checks the passage image by image on the tracings.

targets.name: Voynich: a manually executable generator that matches held-out structural fingerprints, or a decisive falsification of the Naibbe cipher
targets.statement: The Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408) is unread. It is still open whether the text is an enciphered natural language, a constructed system, or meaningless. Greshko's Naibbe cipher (Cryptologia, Nov 2025) is a verbose homophonic substitution of Latin/Italian, executable with cards and dice, that reproduces many Voynich statistics at once. Two 2026 papers add structural fingerprints that no generator was designed for. Parisel (arXiv 2604.25979) shows the Currier A/B split reduces to a per-folio boolean switch on the vowel after ch/sh. Rozanova & Temerev (arXiv 2608.17096) show that glyph regularity exceeds simple substitution, that structure concentrates at token edges, and that spaces form two regimes. The open sub-problem: does any historically plausible, hand-executable generator reproduce all known fingerprints, including ones not used in its design? Already published: Naibbe fails edge-glyph coupling (about 0.006 bits vs the manuscript's 0.197) and the singleton-type rate (about 41-42% vs about 70%) per arXiv 2608.17096 Table 7, independently reproduced by voynich-collective PR #16 (2026-09-19); slot and Cardan-grille generators fail the four-signature joint test calibrated per Currier dialect (arXiv 2604.19762, Apr 2026). Status as of 2026-10-03: Unsolved; no accepted decipherment as of 2026-10-03. The leading hand-executable generator, Naibbe (Greshko, Cryptologia 2025), matches glyph-level entropy, BPE gap and token order. It is published to fail edge-glyph coupling and the hapax-rich vocabulary (Rozanova & Temerev arXiv 2608.17096, Aug 2026; voynich-collective PR #16, Sept 2026). Slot and grille generators fail the 4-signature joint test (arXiv 2604.19762, Apr 2026).
targets.success_criterion: Two outcomes qualify. (A) A generator. It must reproduce, per Currier dialect (A and B separately) and on both ZL3b and IT2a, all of the following within the 95% envelope of the Voynich values: (i) the two Naibbe failure statistics as defined in 2608.17096, edge-glyph coupling (bits and share of entropy) and singleton-type rate; (ii) all four signatures of 2604.19762; (iii) Parisel's per-folio switch statistic. It must also reproduce at least 4 further pre-registered statistics never used in tuning (held out). It must be hand-executable: at most 200 table entries plus a written procedure, and at most 1 per-folio state bit beyond the tables. Run it on at least 20 plaintexts from at least 2 period languages x 10 seeds. If space-regime statistics are included, the generator must emit its own uncertain-space channel under a pre-declared rule. (B) A falsification of Naibbe on a pre-registered statistic NOT among edge-glyph coupling, singleton or hapax rate, the 2604.19762 signatures, or limitations in Greshko 2025. Naibbe output (unmodified author code, default parameters, at least 20 plaintexts x 10 seeds) must fall outside the 99.9% Voynich envelope on A and B and on both transliterations. Neither outcome is a decipherment. The 95% and 99.9% envelopes are computed at verification time from ZL3b-n.txt and IT2a-n.txt as then published; any generator or falsification published after 2026-10-03 that already achieves the claimed outcome voids novelty.

partial_wins.statement: A hand-executable generator (at most 200 table entries plus a written procedure, at most 1 per-folio state bit) whose output, over at least 20 plaintexts from at least 2 period languages x 10 seeds, falls inside the 95% Voynich envelope for BOTH Naibbe failure statistics of arXiv 2608.17096 (edge-glyph coupling in bits and share of entropy; singleton-type rate), on Currier A and B separately and on both ZL3b and IT2a, while staying inside the envelope on h2 conditional entropy and the word-length distribution.

A hand-executable generator (same limits) that passes all four signatures of arXiv 2604.19762 jointly, per Currier dialect and on both transliterations, which the published slot and Cardan-grille generators fail.

A single per-folio state bit added to the unmodified Naibbe tables (no other parameter change) that reproduces Parisel's (arXiv 2604.25979) per-folio ch/sh-vowel switch statistic inside the 95% envelope on Currier A and B and both transliterations, while not leaving the envelope on any statistic Naibbe already matches.

targets.verification_method: The verifier downloads ZL3b-n.txt and IT2a-n.txt (both returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-03; record hashes) and parses IVTFF with Currier tags. It reimplements every statistic independently, including the 2608.17096 and 2604.19762 definitions, and confirms its reimplementation reproduces their published Voynich and Naibbe values before scoring the claim. It runs the submitted generator with its own plaintexts and seeds, checks the pre-registration timestamp in git, and for (B) runs greshko/naibbe-cipher unmodified.

targets.name: MOONSHOT: Voynich manuscript, a key that decrypts held-out folios into meaningful text
targets.statement: Find a key or procedure that maps Voynichese to plaintext in a natural language, and that generalizes to folios not used in building it. Status as of 2026-10-03: Unsolved as of 2026. Multiple 2026 claims (Delgado's Latin, a Galician reading) have no acceptance. The Naibbe cipher (2025) is a generation model, not a decryption.
targets.success_criterion: All of these must hold. (1) The key is fully specified and deterministic, or has bounded ambiguity of at most 2 readings per token, and is frozen before testing. (2) Applied unchanged to at least 10 held-out folios chosen by the verifier, it yields text whose per-character perplexity under a period language model (for example, a 15th-century Latin or Italian corpus) is at least 1.5 bits/char better than the same key applied to glyph-shuffled versions of those folios. (3) Key description length plus plaintext entropy is less than the entropy of the Voynich text under its best compressor (an MDL check against key overfitting). (4) At least 3 plant or star names decrypted on herbal or astro folios match identifications agreed by an independent botanist or astronomer reviewer who has not seen the claimed reading. (5) The frozen key applied to (a) Naibbe-cipher output encrypting a different language and (b) an arXiv 2604.19762-style slot-generator output must give per-character perplexity at least 1.0 bits/char worse than on the held-out Voynich folios. A key that 'decrypts' generated gibberish equally well is rejected.

partial_wins.statement: A frozen key (deterministic, at most 2 readings per token) that, on at least 10 verifier-chosen held-out folios, gives per-character perplexity under an independent period language model at least 1.5 bits/char better than on glyph-shuffled versions of those folios AND at least 1.0 bits/char better than on the verifier-generated structured-gibberish controls (Naibbe output of a different language; slot-generator output), i.e. criteria (2) and (5) without (3) and (4).

Blind illustration match alone: a frozen key decrypts at least 3 plant or star names on verifier-chosen herbal or astronomical folios that match identifications made independently by a botanist or astronomer reviewer who has not seen the claimed reading, while the same key applied to the structured-gibberish controls yields no such matches.

targets.verification_method: The verifier selects held-out folios with its own seed, runs the frozen key, and computes the perplexity against shuffled controls with an independent language model. It checks the MDL accounting and arranges the blind illustration-match review. Additionally, the verifier generates the structured controls itself with fresh seeds and scores them under the same period language model.
